title: Employ only people allowed to work in Australia
what: An employer must not allow an unlawful non-citizen to work, so it checks workers' right to work (s 245AB; taking reasonable steps to verify is a defence, s 245AB(2)).

sources.title: Migration Act 1958
sources.quote: 245AB Allowing an unlawful non-citizen to work (1) A person (the first person) contravenes this subsection if: (a) the first person allows, or continues to allow, another person (the worker) to work; and (b) the worker is an unlawful non-citizen.
